steps.command:
sbx run <<'EOF'
cat /app/my-sql-query.sql
echo "-----SCHEMA-----"
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite ".schema"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /app
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index';"
echo "--- counts ---"
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT 'words',count(*) FROM words UNION ALL SELECT 'senses',count(*) FROM senses UNION ALL SELECT 'synsets',count(*) FROM synsets;"
echo "--- dup checks ---"
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT synsetid FROM synsets GROUP BY synsetid HAVING count(*)>1);"
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT wordid FROM words GROUP BY wordid HAVING count(*)>1);"
echo "--- sense dup word/synset ---"
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT wordid,synsetid FROM senses GROUP BY wordid,synsetid HAVING count(*)>1);"
echo "--- version ---"
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "select sqlite_version();"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /app
echo "--- all senses have synset? ---"
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT count(*) FROM senses s LEFT JOIN synsets sy ON s.synsetid=sy.synsetid WHERE sy.synsetid IS NULL;"
echo "--- all senses have word? ---"
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT count(*) FROM senses s LEFT JOIN words w ON s.wordid=w.wordid WHERE w.wordid IS NULL;"
echo "--- orig plan ---"
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN $(cat my-sql-query.sql)"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /app
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT wordid,synsetid FROM senses);"
cat > /tmp/cand.sql <<'SQL'
WITH sense_cnt AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM senses
  GROUP BY wordid, synsetid
),
word_stats AS (
  SELECT sc.wordid,
         SUM(sc.cnt) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,
         COUNT(DISTINCT sy.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT sy.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM sense_cnt sc
  JOIN synsets sy ON sc.synsetid = sy.synsetid
  GROUP BY sc.wordid
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wordid ORDER BY cnt DESC, synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM sense_cnt
)
SELECT ws.wordid AS word_id,
       w.word AS word,
       ws.total_synsets,
       ws.total_senses,
       ws.distinct_domains,
       ws.distinct_posids,
       r.synsetid AS top_synsetid,
       r.cnt AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM word_stats ws
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = ws.wordid
JOIN ranked r ON r.wordid = ws.wordid AND r.rn = 1
WHERE ws.total_synsets >= 2
  AND ws.distinct_domains >= 2
  AND ws.total_senses >= 2
ORDER BY ws.total_senses DESC, ws.total_synsets DESC, ws.distinct_domains DESC, ws.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
SQL
echo "--- plan ---"
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN $(cat /tmp/cand.sql)"
echo "--- time cand ---"
time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite ".timer on" "$(cat /tmp/cand.sql)" > /tmp/cand.out
wc -l /tmp/cand.out
head -5 /tmp/cand.out
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /app
echo "--- time orig ---"
time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "$(cat my-sql-query.sql)" > /tmp/orig.out
wc -l /tmp/orig.out
echo "--- diff ---"
diff /tmp/orig.out /tmp/cand.out && echo "IDENTICAL"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /app
cut -d'|' -f1 /tmp/cand.out > /tmp/ids.txt
IDS=$(paste -sd, /tmp/ids.txt)
cat > /tmp/verify.sql <<SQL
SELECT
  w.wordid AS word_id, w.word AS word, total_synsets, total_senses, distinct_domains, distinct_posids,
  (SELECT s.synsetid FROM senses s WHERE s.wordid = w.wordid GROUP BY s.synsetid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.synsetid ASC LIMIT 1) AS top_synsetid,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senses s WHERE s.wordid = w.wordid AND s.synsetid = (SELECT s2.synsetid FROM senses s2 WHERE s2.wordid = w.wordid GROUP BY s2.synsetid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s2.synsetid ASC LIMIT 1)) AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM (
  SELECT w.wordid, w.word,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
    COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM words w
  JOIN senses s ON w.wordid = s.wordid
  JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid
  WHERE w.wordid IN ($IDS)
  GROUP BY w.wordid, w.word
  HAVING total_synsets >= 2 AND distinct_domains >= 2 AND total_senses >= 2
) w
ORDER BY total_senses DESC, total_synsets DESC, distinct_domains DESC, word_id ASC
LIMIT 500;
SQL
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "$(cat /tmp/verify.sql)" > /tmp/verify.out
wc -l /tmp/verify.out
diff /tmp/verify.out /tmp/cand.out && echo "IDENTICAL-TO-ORIGINAL-SEMANTICS"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'

ls -la oewn.sqlite
cp oewn.sqlite /tmp/idx.sqlite
sqlite3 /tmp/idx.sqlite "CREATE INDEX ix_senses_word ON senses(wordid, synsetid); CREATE INDEX ix_synsets ON synsets(synsetid, domainid, posid); CREATE INDEX ix_words ON words(wordid);"
echo "--- orig on indexed copy ---"

wc -l /tmp/orig.out
echo "--- cand ---"
time sqlite3 /tmp/idx.sqlite "$(cat /tmp/cand.sql 2>/dev/null || echo 'missing')" > /tmp/cand.out 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -s /tmp/cand.sql ]; then time sqlite3 /tmp/idx.sqlite "$(cat /tmp/cand.sql)" > /tmp/cand.out; fi
wc -l /tmp/cand.out
diff /tmp/orig.out /tmp/cand.out && echo IDENTICAL
EOF

  FROM senses
  GROUP BY wordid
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 AND MIN(synsetid) <> MAX(synsetid)
),
stats AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.wordid, sm.total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
         COUNT(DISTINCT sy.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT sy.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM senses s
  JOIN simple sm ON sm.wordid = s.wordid
  JOIN synsets sy ON s.synsetid = sy.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sy.domainid) >= 2
),
top_words AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT ws.wordid, w.word, ws.total_synsets, ws.total_senses, ws.distinct_domains, ws.distinct_posids
  FROM stats ws JOIN words w ON w.wordid = ws.wordid
  ORDER BY ws.total_senses DESC, ws.total_synsets DESC, ws.distinct_domains DESC, ws.wordid ASC
  LIMIT 500
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT s.wordid, s.synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.wordid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM senses s JOIN top_words tw ON tw.wordid = s.wordid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
)
SELECT tw.wordid AS word_id, tw.word AS word, tw.total_synsets, tw.total_senses,
       tw.distinct_domains, tw.distinct_posids, r.synsetid AS top_synsetid, r.cnt AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM top_words tw JOIN ranked r ON r.wordid = tw.wordid AND r.rn = 1
ORDER BY tw.total_senses DESC, tw.total_synsets DESC, tw.distinct_domains DESC, tw.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
SQL
# correctness vs original on indexed copy
cp oewn.sqlite /tmp/idx.sqlite
sqlite3 /tmp/idx.sqlite "CREATE INDEX ix_senses_word ON senses(wordid, synsetid); CREATE INDEX ix_synsets ON synsets(synsetid, domainid, posid); CREATE INDEX ix_words ON words(wordid);"
sqlite3 /tmp/idx.sqlite "$(cat my-sql-query.sql)" > /tmp/orig.out
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "$(cat _final.sql)" > /tmp/final.out
echo "orig=$(wc -l < /tmp/orig.out) final=$(wc -l < /tmp/final.out)"
diff /tmp/orig.out /tmp/final.out && echo IDENTICAL
echo "--- timing final (no indexes, 8 runs) ---"
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do s=$(date +%s%N); sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "$(cat _final.sql)" >/dev/null; e=$(date +%s%N); echo "$(( (e-s)/1000000 )) ms"; done
echo "--- plan ---"
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN $(cat _final.sql)"
EOF
